title: It has potential, but needs a UI overhaul
body: I bought a physical time timer so I got access to the upgraded app for a 1 year trial. I like the potential that this app has, especially for creating a chain of sequential timers to plan out your day, but the UI is incredibly confusing and clunky. For example, I created a series of sequential timers in a group, but wanted to adjust the time in one of them, but nothing I clicked would allow me to do so. I had to turn off the sequential timer feature first to the click on the timer I wanted to change (and you sometimes had to do this repeatedly as it first selects the timers before it in the sequence) to edit it, then turn back on the sequential feature. The overall navigation needs some work. I do like the different sound effect and color options. I’m not 100% sure I will pay for this once my trial is over.

title: Déjà acheté et je dois repasser à la caisse ?
body:
J’ai acheté cette app en 2020. J’avais la possibilité d’ajouter autant de time que je voulais. Depuis moins d un an (j’ai cherché à revenir à la version précédente sans succès), l’app est passée sur un modèle free/premium avec une mise à jour. Je suis limité à 2 timers (ce qui me pose problème dans mon travail). Je n’ai pas la possibilité de retrouver l’app que j’avais et je dois repasser à la caisse avec un système d’abonnement ! Cette app est bien mais le modèle économique est une grosse escroquerie pour celui ou celle qui avait déjà payé l’application. 
Quelle solution proposez vous llc ?

title: *Chief’s kiss*
body:
Handy app which wonderfully fulfills its purposes, it shattered my expectations the moment I pressed my greasy thumb on the app icon, leaving me in a awe no mortal being dared to experience until this faithful day.
Through my pathologically dilated pupils, my mere human soul was blessed with a glimpse of Heaven. My grotesque jaw fell off the floor discovering the feature of multiple timers and I have stopped counting the times I fainted from pleasure as I reached climax with every alarm going off. 
Alas, I emerged from my deep slumber with a hazy mind yet filled with sorrow that it was all a dream. But then I noticed the pristine white screen of my iPad from a distance : it was all very real and tangible.

The cherry on top ? No ads.

Yet I have three (3) teeny-tiny, little, negligible suggestions to beg to the almighty devs so please hear me out:

- Add a slider for days in the custom timers, the 99h are NOT cutting it. Case example: I’d love to set up an alarm going off in 5 days and 4 hours (124h).

-Add an infinite loop for timers, the 99 loops are NOT cutting it.
Case example : I’d love to set up an alarm going off in 5 days and 4 hours until the end of times.

-Add an option to start the timer at a certain time of the day or in a set amount of time (« in » and « at »).
Cas example 1 : Case example : I’d love to set up an alarm going off in 5 days and 4 hours until the end of times but I want it to start in 3 minutes and 5 seconds, no more, no less.
Case example : I’d love to set up an alarm going off in 5 days and 4 hours until the end of times but I want it to start at 7AM, 3 minutes and 5 seconds, no more, no less.

Hope your life is okay.
